extraction.name: arabic-img2md
extraction.description: A synthetic dataset consisting of 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations, designed to enable accurate and scalable Arabic OCR training and evaluation.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Generated by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to pair Arabic book pages with their Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content from the Hindawi website.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Converting scraped HTML content into PDFs and extracting Markdown text to generate paired image-Markdown samples.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Synthetically generated pairs of rendered Arabic book page images and their corresponding extracted Markdown representations.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Aims to promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic and support downstream NLP and Arabic OCR research.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: Derived from Hindawi's web content, the dataset may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: May not generalize well to domains beyond Hindawi's web content (such as scientific, religious, or historical documents). Performance on multilingual documents or mixed-script content has not been extensively tested. May not handle highly irregular or multi-modal layouts (dense tables, charts, or images) without additional preprocessing.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training and evaluating OCR models for converting Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text.
